criteria.evidence: All numeric and relational claims in executive_summary and negotiation_analysis reconcile with the case data: $7,225=$3,400+$3,825 (F-214/F-115/F-116), $2,125=5×$425 disputed units (E-3), $11,920=$10,070+$1,850 (F-215/F-216/F-217), $4,695 gap (F-218), $7,645 conservative band (F-220), and the 83.77%/8.51%/49.93% comparable medians (F-223-225) all match. Minor imprecision only: contract clause citations like [CT-2], [CT-3], [CT-6] aren't independently defined in the provided data but are supported by the corresponding contract.* facts (F-190/F-191, F-192/F-193, F-198), so they pass as elsewhere-supported.

The reply says 'We don't currently have that specification on hand' (not 'unavailable/impossible'), keeps the EDI-vs-POD discrepancy open ('we're glad to work through that discrepancy with you'), keeps salvage and repack-labor classification open ('confirming... will share that documentation once we have it'), and explicitly disclaims the markdown as a covered loss rather than asserting entitlement. No commitment exceeds what E-1 through E-7 and the gaps (G-01–G-04) support.

The counter ($11,920.00, F-217), the conceded markdown (recommendation to concede outright + reply's 'We're not asking BlueLine to treat this as a covered loss'), the held/pursued items (disputed 5 units, inspection fee, repack labor all included in the $10,070 core_high per F-215), and the freight refund framed strictly as a 'goodwill gesture'/'commercial accommodation' (never as entitlement, consistent with E-7 GOODWILL_LEVER and F-216) are identical across executive_summary, negotiation_analysis, recommended_next_steps, and draft_reply.

Recommendations are explicitly flagged ('Recommendation: given this exclusion, Northstar should concede the markdown outright...'), and open items are hedged appropriately, e.g. 'though that note speaks to the pallet's condition generally, not to a specific carton count [F-095]' and 'offers some support against a pure insufficient-packaging defense, even without the vendor specification' — no speculation is presented as settled fact.

The brief covers the disputed 5 damaged units (para 2), the markdown exclusion (para 3), the EDI-vs-POD conflict (exec summary, para 1, recommended_next_steps item 6), the freight-refund goodwill framing (para 3, exec summary), and all four evidence gaps G-01–G-04 (para 2, para 6, recommended_next_steps, risks_and_watchouts).
